reset_simulation: reset the minitaur simulation with randomized terrain and run 100 warmup steps
load_random_terrain: load a random terrain obj file from a directory and copy it to storage
create_collision_shape: create a collision shape from a terrain mesh file with a 0.5 scale factor
create_multibody_terrain: create a multi-body terrain object with zero mass and no visual shape
apply_action_minitaur: apply a PD control action with pi/2 motor angles to all 8 motors
